title: Claims System Reference — Recording Exam Visit Decisions on Vision Plans Claims
content:
**Subject.** Cascade decides the plan's payment for an **exam visit** on a Vision Plans enrollment and records that decision on the claim. An exam visit is the routine eye exam line of a claim, together with the claim's contact-lens fitting line when the claim carries no contact-lens line. The decision covers the visit as a whole: which of its lines are paid, which are denied and why, and the single amount Cascade pays for the visit. Once recorded, the claim's lines show their remarks and the amount on the member's claim history.

**Scope.** This rule governs exam visits only. A fitting on a contact-lens order is settled under the contact-lens order rule and a stand-alone fitting under the stand-alone fitting rule. Every other service remains under the general in-network benefit rule. For exam visits, benefit frequency and contacts-in-lieu are counted under this rule, from the latest paid or reimbursed service of the kind under the current enrollment, a reversal counting only when it reverses the one service on that latest date. The rules for eyeglasses orders, contact-lens orders, out-of-network claims settled on their glasses part or on their contact-lens part, and stand-alone contact-lens fittings count them the same way. Services paid by another carrier still do not count.

## The recording tool

**Capability.** `decide_exam_visit_80d2e33d` records Cascade's decision on the exam visit — the routine eye exam and any contact-lens fitting of one claim — carrying the claim number. It decides at once the claim's open routine eye exam line and, on a claim without a contact-lens line, its open fitting line; open lines are lines carrying no remark yet or standing denied as not eligible. The claim's other lines are left as they are. Each line given a remark argument receives that denial remark. Every other line receives the paid remark of its channel: `PAID` at a participating location, `PAID_OON_REIMBURSEMENT` at a provider without a Cascade agreement. The amount is booked on the first line not denied, in the order exam, fitting, contact lenses, lenses, frame (the first line when every line is denied), with no separate amount on the other lines. Every line's decision date is set to today. After the call the claim's lines show these remarks and the amount on the member's claim history.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `decide_exam_visit_80d2e33d` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

- `claim_number` — the claim number of the claim, copied character for character from the vision claim lookup, with its letters, digits and hyphens unchanged.
- `plan_paid` — the amount Cascade pays for the whole visit, 0.00 when the plan pays nothing, in USD, a non-negative number given to 2 decimal places (cents), rounded half up to the cent.
- `exam_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's routine eye exam line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.
- `fitting_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's contact-lens fitting line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.

A remark argument left as an empty text leaves that line to receive the paid remark of its channel.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text means the claim is recorded. It carries `claim_number` (the claim recorded), `plan_paid` (the amount booked, USD with 2 decimal places), `lines` (each recorded line's reference number mapped to the remark now recorded) and `adjudicated_date` (today's date, year-month-day). A text starting "No open claim line" means no open line carries that claim number.
